meta.name: autonomous-investigation
meta.description: The protocol behind every investigation skill. Use when AI research must proceed without you: search-plan gate, Fact/Inference/Assumption labels, confidence stacking, diffable outputs.

copy.tagline: 让AI研究自动进行，无需人工介入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要AI自主完成多步骤调研并输出结构化结果
copy.tagline_en: Let AI research proceed without manual intervention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to autonomously conduct multi-step research and output structured results

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按自主调查协议开展研究：先展示 3 条搜索计划，再将每条关键信息标为“事实/推断/假设”并附可查网址；无人回答也会继续，用精简模式输出稳定格式的报告，最后给 4 个后续选项。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在你不用盯场的情况下开展调研，例如进行自主调查、竞品扫描、市场监测等，或某个调查技能引用了本协议时触发。

say.text: 请按自主调查协议，调查一下 X 公司进入办公自动化领域的动作。
say.note: Claude 会先给出搜索计划，再带着标签输出结果。

say.text: 用不超过 3 个问题做一次竞品扫描，输出事实/推断/假设标签。
say.note: 它会限制澄清问题数，未答即用假设继续。

say.text: 把这次市场调研做成可调度任务，每季度自动重跑一遍。
say.note: 输出结构稳定，可对比季度差异。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the protocol: shows a 3-bullet search plan, labels every key claim Fact/Inference/Assumption with URLs, proceeds if unanswered, outputs stable diffable results, and ends with 4 next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for autonomous investigation (e.g., competitive scan, market watch) or when another investigation skill references this protocol.

say_en.text: Run an autonomous investigation on X's move into workflow automation, per the protocol.
say_en.note: Claude shows a plan, then labeled findings.

say_en.text: Do a competitive scan with at most 3 questions, output with labels.
say_en.note: It caps clarifying questions and proceeds on assumptions.

say_en.text: Make this market scan a scheduled task, rerun quarterly.
